about: Twenty's company avatars as they ship (twentyhq/twenty e79b3365): its own URL builder from twenty-shared, no SDK and no key (the service is public), loads the favicon of a company it prefills in every new workspace, asserting a 192-pixel PNG, and the vendor's 404 for a domain the World does not know. The World knows the prefilled companies from the pack's default data.

files..env.example: # twenty-icons.com is public: Twenty sends no key

retention.none: Twenty only reads favicons: it stores nothing at twenty-icons.com and holds no account there, so there is no record of the app's to read back.
